decisions.title: Code target, prototype depth, design.md as the source of truth
decisions.rationale: The site is already in code; design.md holds the approved tokens; prototype covers the three existing screens

decisions.title: Storybook with @storybook-astro/framework
decisions.rationale: Official Storybook has no Astro renderer; the community framework 1.15 matches Astro 7, Vitest 5 and TypeScript 6. The first code batch verifies it; fallback is a /design-system page in Astro

decisions.title: Components in src/components/ui, state files public in the repo
decisions.rationale: Single app, no monorepo; state files contain no private data

decisions.title: Shortlist: 12 components plus Prose
decisions.rationale: Card, LinkCard, Button, Copy command, Inline code, Text link, Badge, Disclosure, Icon, Page header, Section header, Callout; Prose stays a style; Process flow excluded; Table decided later

decisions.title: Card and LinkCard as separate components
decisions.rationale: Owner prefers a clear split between a static block and a link, accepting two places for the shared look
alternatives: one Card with an href property

decisions.title: Visual direction review skipped
decisions.rationale: design.md stays the source of truth for the look (D-001)

decisions.title: Actor tokens color.actor.skill and color.actor.you
decisions.rationale: Same values as info and warning, without their status meaning; contrast 10.4 and 11.5

decisions.title: Cards exactly as design.md: padding 2rem, 2rem between children, no border
decisions.rationale: Owner keeps design.md as is, accepting looser cards that blend with the page background in light mode
alternatives: 0.75rem title gap and 1px border.subtle added to design.md

decisions.title: heading-small line height 1.3
decisions.rationale: Two-line titles on phones were cramped at 1.1; one value replaces the overrides in code

decisions.title: Foundations approved
decisions.rationale: design.md tokens imported 1:1 plus approved additions: actor colors, code text style, border widths 1px and 2px, card spacing tokens; light and dark by system setting; WCAG 2.2 AA baseline; primary button deferred for contrast; additions written back to design.md

decisions.title: Blueprint and four code batches
decisions.rationale: B1 foundations and Storybook first to verify D-002, then primitives, composites, patterns with screen migration; owner approves each batch; B1 starts in a new session

decisions.title: Dark theme follows the system setting without JavaScript
decisions.rationale: Exporter also emits a prefers-color-scheme dark block for :root without data-theme=light; data-theme still overrides, used by Storybook

decisions.title: Rem units in code for font sizes and spacing
decisions.rationale: Reopens D-010 for units only: blueprint keeps px, exporter writes rem (16px = 1rem) except border widths, so browser text size settings keep working (WCAG 1.4.4); no visual change at default size

decisions.title: B1 foundations accepted
decisions.rationale: pnpm check exit 0; Storybook on Astro 7 verified; foundations reviewed in Color, Typography and Spacing stories

decisions.title: B2 primitives accepted
decisions.rationale: All five checks pass; owner reviewed the Primitives stories in Storybook; components stay needs_review for a developer

decisions.title: B3 composites accepted
decisions.rationale: All five checks pass; owner reviewed Composites stories and the migrated cards; table and file list borders stay as they are for now
